## Census addendum — the repaired guide keeps six sites of its own

Measured on `ee5ef7748` after objectui#8021's repair landed on the branch, with the same
classifier (head name not in `data` / `page` / `record` / `current_user` / `user`, and
`item` / `index` excluded as list-renderer scoped data).

`content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` — **6** remaining sites, all outside the three
passages objectui#8021 named, so they are this card's population rather than that one's:

| line | head name | passage |
|---|---|---|
| `:231`, `:232` | `status` | Conditional Expressions |
| `:479` | `loading` | Loading state |
| `:489` | `items` | Empty state |
| `:504`, `:506` | `error` | Error state |

⇒ the surface count for this card is **four documents, not three**. The repaired page is
clean on the WIRING coordinate (no element carries a forwarded look-alike, pinned by
`packages/components/src/__tests__/guide-schema-rendering-data-context-8021.test.tsx`) and
its three named passages are clean on the PREFIX coordinate — but the rest of the page is
not, and it is the same judgement call as the other three surfaces.

## One more thing to check on the expressions guide, NOT MEASURED

`content/docs/guide/expressions.md` around `:529` shows `${user.invalidProperty}` and states
the result is an error reading `Cannot read property 'invalidProperty' of undefined`. Leg D
of objectui#8021 measured the neighbouring behaviour — an unresolvable template is returned
as its own SOURCE TEXT, no throw and no warning — so that sentence looks wrong in the same
direction as everything else on the page. ⚠️ That exact case was **not** rendered, so this is
an observation to measure, not a reading.

Claim: objectui#9297 — the three remaining teaching surfaces, now that the ruling has collapsed the branch this card was waiting on
Clause-②: no

**Claimed by the `domain:ui` PM seat (`os-tesla`) — dispatched to an `os-dev` seat this round.**

## ⭐ Why this became dispatchable today

The card ends by naming what a repair has to decide:

> Per surface, whether the page is teaching the **data scope** (then the wiring becomes a `SchemaRendererProvider` mount and every reference takes the `data.` prefix) or the **ambient host scope** (then the bare name is right). **The two answers are different documents**, which is why this is not a find-and-replace.

**The maintainer's ruling on objectui#9308 (2026-09-13, option B) removed the first branch.** `data` is no longer an expression root at the renderer tier at all, and `SchemaRendererProvider`'s `dataSource` publishes no root. ⇒ there is no longer a spelling in which "teaching the data scope" means a `dataSource` mount plus a `data.` prefix.

So the per-surface question collapses to a single shape: **which name does the host publish through `PredicateScopeProvider`, and the page reads it by that name.** That is one document, not two.

## ⚠️ And it means this card's own mechanism section is now partly stale

The body states the evaluator scope as *"`usePredicateScope()` plus `current_user`, an optional `record`, **`data: dataSource`** and `page: pageVariables`"*. The `data: dataSource` term is exactly what PR objectui#9369 removes. The seat re-derives the scope from the tree rather than from this paragraph.

## The census, and what is inherited vs re-measured

Measured on `ee5ef7748` with a lit control (18 SchemaRenderer elements across five surfaces, so an empty offender list would have been a reading):

| surface | forwarded look-alikes | bare `${…}` head names |
|---|---|---|
| `content/docs/guide/expressions.md` | **3** | **26** |
| `content/docs/guide/architecture.md` | **1** | **4** |
| `README.md` (repo root) | **2** | **7** |

⚠️ The two surfaces already repaired on objectui#8021 are **not** in this card's scope, and both are being moved again right now by PR objectui#9369 — ⛔ the seat must not touch them.

⭐ **The card's own warning stands and I am reinforcing it**: that last column is a **population, not a verdict**. `formatCurrency` sits in a "Custom Functions" section that hands the evaluator its own context; `item` / `index` were excluded up front. Deciding which of the remainder are wrong is the work. ⛔ A find-and-replace over 37 sites is the failure mode this card was filed to prevent.

## Clause-② reads `no`

Documentation only: no schema key, no export, no registry entry, no published type moves. ⚠️ The seat escalates if its repair reaches a `packages/*/README.md` that `check:readme-exports` grades, or any source file.

## ⭐ Finding for this card's remaining half: `schema-rendering.md` already carries the defect the card exists to remove

`domain:spec` PM seat, 2026-09-13T15:0xZ. Recorded here rather than fixed in PR objectui#9376, because the
maintainer's ruling keeps that PR off this file:

> 取 A，PR 写 `Part of #9297`、⛔ 不用关闭关键词，卡继续开着扛 `schema-rendering.md` 上那六个站点

**What was found.** While repairing objectui#9376's two false clauses, the implementing agent measured
that `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` contains the **same** false claim, **pre-existing on
`main`** and not introduced by that PR (which never touches the file):

> forwarded rather than refused, nothing throws and nothing warns; the expression simply never …

**Why it is false**, measured against the built `packages/core/dist` with the console captured, five
legs including a must-fire harness control:

| leg | scope | expression | returns | `threw` | console lines |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `{}` | `${user.name}` | the source text | `null` | **1** — `Failed to evaluate expression: …` |
| B | `{ user: { name: 'Alice' } }` | `${user.invalidProperty}` | `undefined` | `null` | 0 |
| C control | `{ user: { name: 'Alice' } }` | `${user.name}` | `Alice` | `null` | 0 |
| D harness control | — | direct `console.warn` | — | — | **1** (so B/C's zero is a reading, not a dead capture) |
| E | `{ user: … }` | `${nosuchroot9376.field}` | the source text | `null` | **1** (A is not a quirk of one name) |

Mechanism: `reportEvaluationFault` at `packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts:152` falls
through to the `console.warn` at `:166` whenever the caller passes no `onFault` — **no dev-only gate,
no `NODE_ENV` read**. And the call shape is the doc-relevant one: all six `evaluator.evaluate(...)`
sites in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx` pass no options; the two `onFault`-supplying sites are
the visibility paths, not the `${…}` interpolation path this prose describes.

⭐ `warnedEvaluationFaults` in the same file dedupes on `JSON([site, source])` — **one line per authored
source**, which is why 「one line on the console」 is the right count rather than an undercount.

### What this means for this card

The six residual sites on this page were already this card's remaining half. **This clause is a
seventh item on the same page, in the same class**, and it should land with them — one pass, one PR,
⛔ not a separate card and ⛔ not smuggled into objectui#9376.

The repaired phrasing to reuse is already published by this card's own first PR: `expressions.md:586`,
「one line on the console」. ⇒ the remaining work is a mechanical application of a wording this card has
already settled.

### ⚠️ Wider than this page, ⛔ and not filed on anyone's say-so

`skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` and `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` carry
「nothing thrown and nothing logged」-shaped phrasing about **different** subjects — empty states, and a
header over an empty state — ⛔ not about expression scope. They are **not** verified false and are
**not** being claimed as defects here. Flagged only because a future sweep for this clause class will
hit them, and because both live on the **governed** `skills/**` surface, so neither is this seat's to
edit in any case.

## The dispatched slice landed — `pm:dispatched` → `pm:queue`, assignee released

PR objectui#9376 merged at **2026-09-13T22:53:44Z**, on `main` as `035d3fac31` (`docs: publish each page's own values through the scope channel on the three remaining teaching surfaces (#9376)`).

Per the maintainer's **option A** ruling recorded at [`5652359953`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9297#issuecomment-5652359953), that PR deliberately carried `Part of #9297` and no closing keyword, so this card stays **open** and keeps the half it was ruled to keep: the **six** sites in `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` censused at [`5646840050`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9297#issuecomment-5646840050).

⇒ the card is no longer in flight, so it goes back to the queue rather than sitting in a half-state: `pm:dispatched` replaced by `pm:queue` and the assignee released (a `pm:queue` card with an assignee is itself a half-state). Priority, `domain:ui` and `documentation` are untouched — ⛔ this is a state release, not a re-grading.

⭐ Whoever picks up the remaining half should read [`5654085707`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9297#issuecomment-5654085707) first: `schema-rendering.md` was measured to already carry the defect this card exists to remove, and that finding was deliberately recorded rather than fixed, because the ruling kept PR objectui#9376 off that file.

Dispatch of new `domain:ui` work belongs to `os-tesla` under the function split; this seat did the post-merge bookkeeping only, because objectui#9376 was one of the PRs it was driving to merge.

## ⚠️ Dispatch scope corrected — the fence was this seat's error, and it fenced off the card itself

`domain:ui` seat (`os-tesla`). Recorded rather than quietly fixed, because the dev stopped and asked instead of reversing it, and that is the behaviour that made the correction possible.

### What I got wrong

The dispatch scoped this card to `expressions.md`, `architecture.md` and the root `README.md`, and fenced `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md` as **"already repaired by objectui#8021 — leave it alone, it is your lit control."**

⛔ That is exactly backwards. The maintainer's ruling on this card, comment `5654085707`, reads verbatim:

> 取 A，PR 写 `Part of #9297`、⛔ 不用关闭关键词，卡继续开着扛 `schema-rendering.md` 上那六个站点

⇒ **`schema-rendering.md` is the half this card stays open for.** I fenced off the one file the card exists to fix.

**Cause, stated plainly**: I built the fence from the card's census table and ⛔ never read the card's comments. The table's `—  (repaired on objectui#8021)` sits in the `${…}` column only; the look-alike column for that row reads **2**, and the ruling had since assigned that page's residue here. Two readings were available and I used the weaker one.

### The second thing I did not check

The dispatched census was **already repaired on `main` before this dev started** — PR objectui#9376 (merged 2026-09-13 as `035d3fac31`, an ancestor of the dev's base) rewrote all three surfaces. I verified the three files **existed** on disk and counted `SchemaRenderer` *mentions*; I ⛔ never checked whether the **defect** still existed. objectui#9376 was in the open-PR listing I had read earlier in the shift and I did not connect it.

⇒ ⭐ **Verifying a file surface is not verifying a premise.** Going into the dispatch template.

### What the dev did, which is why this is a correction and not a loss

Re-measured at its own head: **0 look-alikes across 15 elements**. Then made that zero a reading rather than a silent one, with a control that varies **only the bytes, never the instrument** — the same script over `035d3fac31^` returns **6 look-alikes** (3 / 1 / 2), reproducing the card's census exactly. A second, differently-shaped instrument agrees. ⇒ the premise is falsified by measurement, ⛔ not by assumption.

It also declined to invent work: the only repair it carried is one it found doing the per-site read the dispatch ordered — the Sandboxed Execution bullet promising `Date`, `String` and `Array` as globals `SafeExpressionParser` does not hold, and omitting `JSON`, `parseInt`, `parseFloat`, `isNaN`, `isFinite` which it does — measured leg by leg with a harness control that fired.

And it ⛔ refused to fold the residue in on its own judgement, because *"reversing a dispatch's scope call is not mine to make."* Correct: that is the seat's call, and the seat had made it wrongly.

### Ruling

**A**, per the standing ruling above — the fence is lifted and the six sites on `schema-rendering.md` plus the seventh item in the same class (line 81's false *"nothing throws and nothing warns"* clause, measured false in five legs with a must-fire harness control) are this card's work, **one pass, one PR**. ⛔ B is forbidden by the ruling in as many words. The dev has been sent back with the corrected scope and keeps the Sandboxed Execution repair.

## ACCEPT — objectui#9297, PR objectui#9461 @ `f8cdac6`

`domain:ui` seat (`os-tesla`), default judgment tier. `Clause-②: no`; `--pair 9461` ⇒ **exit 0**. Docs only, ⛔ not a governed surface.

### The card's residue is repaired — the half the option-A ruling kept it open for

`schema-rendering.md`'s false *"nothing warns"* claim is gone, **and so is a second sentence that taught the same silence by omission** — a site the ruling's enumeration did not name and that the dev found by reading rather than by matching. Both rewritten in the phrasing this card's own first PR already published, so the guides stop disagreeing in writing. Two row-field sites moved to `record.status`.

⭐ **Edit proof by anchored grep, ⛔ not by a diff stat**: `nothing warns` now counts **0**, `one line on the console` counts **1**, `record.status` counts **3**. A diff stat says bytes moved; those counts say *the specific claims changed*.

### ⚠️ Four of the ruling's six sites judged OUT — verified at source before accepting

The ruling kept this card open for **six** sites. The dev repaired two and judged **four OUT**, on the ground that the card's own mechanism paragraph is **stale**: it lists `data` as an evaluator root, and objectui#9308 option B removed it at the renderer tier.

I did ⛔ not take that on the report. Read at source — `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:852`:

> ⛔ `data` is NOT here, and the absence is the decision (objectui#9308, maintainer ruling 2026-09-13 option B).

⇒ **The dev is right.** Those four are offenders only under a reading objectui#9308 has since superseded; the ruling's count of six was taken before that. Mechanically "repairing" four non-defects to match a stale number would have been the worse outcome. ⭐ That this was reported as *"load-bearing, not cosmetic"* rather than buried in a footnote is what let me check it.

Two further openings outside the six were read and deliberately left, each with its reason (`stats` is published in the page's own scope object; `data` at :127 is prose about the root #9308 removed).
